what: Printing press with two wheels — the left wheel holds 16:9 photo cards, the right wheel holds square plates in every slot (40° for 9 slots), meshed and turning in opposite directions (three.js, fov 36°, camera z 3.2, wheel radius 1.14, card width .7, plate width .3). Wheel 1px moves .0011 slot, drag 1px moves .0034 slot, each frame follows .08 of the remaining share, and .16s after release it stops on the nearest slot. The front card scales 1.9× (plate 1.1×) and the card edges bend backward. Wheels tilt x −5°, y 14°, and each slot passes around the rim rotated by its own angle. With a mouse, the closer to the front a slot is, the more it leans toward the cursor (y 1.6, x 1.2 × .1rad, z 1.4 × .02rad, follows .08 per frame — the original’s pLean, pRock, pSide). When the front slot changes, fx:select fires (detail.index, item). Below 768 width, the two wheels are stood up outside, above and below

options.pitch: Angle between card wheel slots (deg), default 60
options.pitch-r: Angle between panel wheel cells (deg), default 83
options.spin: Share by which the cell tilts with its position angle, default .55
options.wheel: Cells turned per 1px of wheel, default .0011
options.bend: Depth at which the front card’s edge curves back, default .07
options.lean: Tilt toward the cursor on y (× .1rad), default 1.6
options.rock: Tilt toward the cursor on x (× .1rad), default 1.2
options.side: Z twist toward the cursor (× .02rad), default 1.4
options.look: If full, the wheel also takes over finger dragging (only when the stage fills the whole screen)

note: The original stage covers a full screen and the wheel also takes vertical finger swipes (look: full). When used as one section inside a page, leave it at default (pan-y) so scroll isn’t blocked on phones. The original ink·gloss·chrome shaders (print metaphor) are not ported, and the panel rim is painted with a skin-color gradient
